opening_intro.text:
Mindfulness / Meditation practice is shown over and over to build mental and emotional strength; improve immune function and overall health; reduce stress, overthinking and negative mind-states; improve focus, creativity and productivity; empower choice in how we respond instead of reacting to life; develop our agency and conscious choice and all together enables us to harness the power of the mind.

It's a long list of potential benefits! 

In the workplace and in life mindfulness and meditation training empowers people to build resilience, increase wellbeing, improve performance, enhance engagement and achieve success.
